## What’s new
- Adds in-app update support on Mac, with an update button when a new version is available. You choose when to install and restart. - Adds support for answering supported Codex filesystem permission requests. - Keeps pending requests available in Paceman when you open Codex or Claude Code.
## Updating
**Mac:** Quit Paceman, open the new DMG, replace Paceman in Applications, and reopen it. This manual upgrade enables future in-app updates. Existing pairings, settings, and activity history are retained. Review changed agent hooks if prompted.
The Mac app is Developer ID signed and notarized. Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 15 or newer.
**Omarchy:** Download the source archive and SHA256SUMS from this release, verify the archive’s checksum, then extract it and rerun the installer. Existing state is preserved. The checksum detects corruption; it is not a separate publisher signature.
## Availability
This release provides the Mac updater for future releases. Existing installations need the manual upgrade above. The stable update feed will be activated after the remaining updater validation.
Some requests still need to be handled in the original agent app.
